text:
emma: idea: 'Peak Pulse & Grip Giggles'  a silly name but hear me out  short week challenge mixing campus sprints and a 15-min grip/climb drill. low commitment.
noah: sounds delightful. what's the format?
emma: Mon/Wed/Fri = 10-min uphill sprints or stair sets. Tue/Thu = 15-min hangboard or campus board basics (beginner options included). 1pt per completed session.
taylor: beginner hangboard? please explain, my fingers are dramatic.
emma: totally  beginner option = 6s hangs on large holds x 6 with plenty rest, or 15min movement circuit on easy problems. advanced folks can do weighted hangs or campus ladders.
rachel: can we have a one-time meetup Wed after work for a group sprint session? good vibes.
omar: I mean emma I'm in if there's coffee afterwards. :coffee:
poll-bot: POLL: "Wednesday meetup for Peak Pulse session"  Options: "6:30 PM Riverside (group)", "No meetup (solo)"  Vote now!
noah: voted 6:30.
taylor: voted 6:30.
emma: rules: post a tiny proof (one selfie, a screenshot, or a quick Strava note) so we can track. no policing, just cheers.
rachel: can we add a micro-prize? loser's choice = buy bagels?
omar: let's not punish the losers too harshly. winner gets coffee + GIF trophy.
noah: also suggestion: add a 'funniest fail' bonus for the most entertaining attempt video.
emma: ha yes 'funniest fail' is a thing. safe and non-embarrassing only.
poll-bot: POLL RESULTS: "Wednesday meetup for Peak Pulse session"  6:30 PM Riverside (group) (4 votes), No meetup (solo) (2 votes).
taylor: ok Riverside it is. meetup Wed 6:30, coffee after.
rachel: planning to hit Crag Club Tue for technique, anyone else join?
omar: maybe. depends on how sore I am from Monday sprints.
emma: kickoff Monday morning  short and sweet. sheet for tracking: https://tinyurl.com/peakpulse (just tick days and add a tiny note).
noah: added. see you all on the stairs and tragically awkward hangboards. :grimacing:
